blocks.text: SHENZHEN, China — President Marcos on Wednesday was personally received by Chinese President Xi Jinping at the opening ceremony of the 33rd Apec Economic Leaders’ Meeting in Shenzhen, China. Marcos and first lady Liza Araneta-Marcos posed for a photo with Xi and his wife, Peng Liyuan, during the event. READ: Marcos now in Shenzhen for 33rd Apec Economic Leaders Meeting Leaders of the 21 Apec member economies and their spouses also joined for a group photo, with the First Couple positioned at the far left.
